Build the future of Social video intelligence

We live in a Video-First world. At Dig, we help global brands see what’s shown, said, and spreading in real time. Join us to build the tech that’s changing how the world understands video.

Join the vibe

Why work at dig?

We’re not just another Tel Aviv startup. 

We’re building Social Video Intelligence from the ground up, and reshaping how brands like P&G and Ferrari thrive in a video-driven world.

Here, you are trusted to lead, encouraged to think bold, and backed to make an impact. We trust you to think boldly and back you to go big. We play to win, not to outshine each other. Ambition here means building something that matters together.

Who we’re looking for

We’re looking for people who want to belong - those who seek meaning, teamwork, and purpose.

You stay calm under pressure. You move fast in changing environments. You’re not afraid of trying or failing, and you know when to speak up and when to listen. You’re the kind of person who makes work better for everyone just by being you.

Apply now

What we give our people

At dig, the vibe is real - we eat lunch together and laugh even when it’s intense.

We show up for each other, in code reviews, in crunch time, and at weddings. We help beyond our roles, and are there for one another. This is a place where students become leaders. Where people grow fast and never alone. You’ll build tech that changes how the world sees video. And you’ll create impact that lasts.

Life at dig

Working at dig means solving problems no one else has cracked yet.

Whether we’re building the future of video intelligence, creating research workflows, or helping top brands, agencies, and governments surface complex narratives, the work here matters.

What defines our culture?

  • Small, senior, high-impact teams
  • Ownership over outcomes 
  • A bias toward clarity & evidence
  • Real responsibility from day one

What you’ll work on

  • Reputation Intelligence

    Detect damaging viral narratives, leaks, deepfakes, and disinformation; quantify impact; power fast responses.

  • Consumer & Content Intelligence

    Benchmark product feedback and brand health, track narrative traction, and identify aligned influencers.

  • Secondary Strengths

    Zero pre-configuration, no-integration TTM, multimodal analysis, optional auto-responses, and fits-your-stack extensibility.
